notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, targeting the Eldrazi.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the Eldrazi.
The Equipment's ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the Eldrazi from exile by paying {0} due to Eye of Ugin.
Repeat.
